name: REVEL
verdict: Private Spanish car-subscription company (Drive REVEL, S.L.), founder-led; KKR and Santander Consumer Finance entered its shareholding in 2023. Nothing found.
note: Rating note: Founder-led private company; the 2023 investors' stakes (KKR, Santander Consumer Finance and others not named) are undisclosed. No state body or fund found in the chain, and no court, regulator, UN body or major-NGO human-rights finding against REVEL found.
